title: Improper access control within the AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware could allow an attacker with…
description: CVE-2025-52537 is a medium severity vulnerability in the AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware involving improper access control. An attacker with administrative privileges could exploit this flaw to tamper with memory, potentially compromising the integrity of guest memory. No public exploits or patches are currently documented.
